title: Discharged from Hospital
desc: After seven nights in hospital, we were officially cleared to start our life at home as a family.
story: The nurses had been wonderful, but the moment we had been waiting for finally came — we were free to go home. The midwife ran through what felt like a hundred instructions while Dad fumbled with the car seat straps. Mum held you snugly, not quite ready to let go. As we walked through those hospital doors, we stepped into our new life together.
